reason: Global marginal and simultaneous risk residual quantiles caused universal fallback. Test standard action-specific corrections before attributing this to a novel reliability problem.

rules.action_residual: Add the per-action mean calibration residual to each model mean, clipped to [0,1].
rules.actionwise_cp: Add a separate per-action split-conformal residual quantile at alpha=0.1; this is action-marginal, NOT selection-valid simultaneous coverage.

scope: Run every original seed, strength, domain and budget; use identical model fits, calibration scenes/latent seeds, reference results and prediction seeds. No parameter tuning or best-seed selection.
novelty_claim: none; conventional diagnostic controls added after reading all-global-calibration fallback results
